steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Engineering problem-solving follows a systematic process: define, research, develop, test, evaluate, iterate. | Key Fact: The design brief defines the problem, requirements, constraints and criteria for success. | Key Fact: A specification translates the brief into measurable technical requirements: dimensions, materials, performance targets. | Key Fact: Research gathers information about existing solutions, materials, processes, user needs and relevant standards.
